signature.name: Space Needle
signature.detail: Seattle's most recognizable icon, offering sweeping views of the city, Puget Sound and Mount Rainier on clear days. Book tickets online in advance and go early morning or near sunset for the best light and smaller crowds.

signature.name: Pike Place Market
signature.detail: A bustling historic market famous for fish throwing, local produce, crafts and the original Starbucks. Arrive before 10am to avoid the biggest crowds, and wear comfortable shoes for the steep streets.

signature.name: Chihuly Garden and Glass
signature.detail: A stunning museum showcasing Dale Chihuly's colorful glass sculptures, with both indoor galleries and an outdoor garden. It sits right next to the Space Needle, so combine both in one visit; tickets are timed.

signature.name: Museum of Pop Culture
signature.detail: A must for music and pop-culture fans, with immersive exhibits on Nirvana, Jimi Hendrix, science fiction and more. The building itself is a landmark; allow at least two hours and check for special exhibitions.

signature.name: Kerry Park
signature.detail: The classic postcard viewpoint of Seattle, with the Space Needle framed against Mount Rainier and the skyline. It's free and especially magical at sunset or on a clear day; go early for parking.

signature.name: Seattle Aquarium
signature.detail: A family-friendly aquarium on the waterfront with local marine life, touch pools and a new Ocean Pavilion. Buy tickets online to skip lines and visit on weekday mornings for a quieter experience.

signature.name: Gas Works Park
signature.detail: A unique park built on a former gasification plant, with industrial relics and great views of Lake Union and the skyline. It's a relaxed spot for a picnic or kite flying; best on sunny afternoons.

signature.name: Fremont Troll
signature.detail: A quirky, giant sculpture under the Aurora Bridge that has become a beloved photo stop. It's free and quick to visit; combine it with a stroll through the Fremont neighborhood's shops and cafes.

transport: Light rail $3 a ride; day pass $6-8; taxis moderate
